facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, under exchange control; keep earnings in a foreign-currency account at a bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: individuals may hold a foreign currency account with an Authorised Dealer.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Paystack Starter takes unregistered sellers, with a limit until you register a business.
facts.L1_registration: No company needed; register with SARS within 21 business days of starting.
facts.L2_tax_id: SARS income tax reference number, via eFiling or the SARS MobiApp.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 18–45%; Turnover Tax excludes most professional services.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 15% VAT above R2.3m a year; services to non-residents are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: POPIA: register your Information Officer with the Information Regulator.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can cancel within 7 days without reason or penalty.
facts.L7_incentives: Turnover Tax 0% up to R600,000, if under 20% professional services.
facts.D1_id_document: Green bar-coded ID book or Smart ID card.

watch_out.text: Remote work done from South Africa doesn't get the foreign-income exchange exemption.
Over 20% income from IT or consulting rules out Turnover Tax.
PayPal withdrawals go through FNB's withdraw service and take 4–6 business days.
